observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A formal, upscale nightclub or ballroom with a stage, featuring classical-style statues and a fire pit.
observation.dancers: A large group of men and women, mixed, performing as a chorus line with a female lead.
observation.formation_and_space: The dancers move in lines, circles, and a long, snake-like procession, utilizing the entire stage space.
observation.posture: Upright torso, knees are frequently bent in a deep, athletic crouch, with weight shifted dynamically.
observation.footwork: Fast, rhythmic stepping, including kicks, pivots, and slides; the steps are syncopated and sharp, often landing on the beat.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms are used expressively, often held high, extended, or bent at the elbows; hands are frequently open, gesturing, or framing the face.
observation.hips_and_torso: Prominent hip isolations, torso twists, and rhythmic shimmies that emphasize the beat.
observation.partnering: Minimal direct contact; the dancers move in unison or in a call-and-response style, with the lead dancer interacting with the group.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent use of deep squats, high kicks, and sharp, rapid turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Women wear short, black, sleeveless dresses with metallic accents and elaborate, colorful wigs; men wear formal tuxedos.
observation.cannot_infer: The fast-paced camera cuts and low-resolution footage make it difficult to determine the exact weight transfer or the complexity of the footwork.

signature_moments.what: The dancers perform a synchronized, sharp, and rhythmic sequence of arm and hip movements while in a deep, crouched position.
The lead dancer walks forward while the chorus line performs a series of sharp, rhythmic kicks and arm gestures.
The dancers pair up and perform a synchronized, deep-crouch hip-sway movement.
The group stands in a line, arms raised high, performing a rhythmic, synchronized torso and arm movement.
